faqs.q: What does Hazard Perception Mock Test 1 cover?
faqs.a: Mock Test 1 focuses on beginner hazard perception skills, including spotting developing hazards, reacting to pedestrians, noticing junction risks and learning when a situation may require you to slow down.

faqs.q: Is this an official DVSA hazard perception test?
faqs.a: No. This is independent hazard perception practice designed to help learners revise and build confidence. It is not an official DVSA test.

faqs.q: How should I use this mock?
faqs.a: Use this mock to practise spotting hazards early, then review your result and focus on the situations you missed before moving to the next mock.

faqs.q: Can I retake this hazard perception mock?
faqs.a: Yes. Retaking the mock can help you notice patterns in the hazards you miss and improve your timing and observation.

faqs.q: What should I focus on during this mock?
faqs.a: Focus on the whole road scene, not just the vehicle in front. Watch pavements, junctions, parked cars and vulnerable road users.

faqs.q: What does Hazard Perception Mock Test 3 cover?
faqs.a: Mock Test 3 focuses on developing traffic hazards, visibility clues, road layout changes and timing your response when a risk begins to develop.

faqs.q: Why is timing important in hazard perception?
faqs.a: Timing matters because the aim is to recognise a developing hazard early enough, not after the danger has already become obvious.
